spans.s:
(ऋ) रेपृ r. 1st cl. (रेपति-ते)
1 To go, to move.
2 To sound.

mfn. (-पः-पा-पं)
1 Low, vile, inferior, contemptible.
2 Cruel, savage.
E.
रि to injure, प aff.

mfn. (-पाः-पाः-पः)
1 Low, vile, contemptible.
2 Cruel, savage.
3 Miserly, niggardly, a miser.
4 Wicked, abandoned.
E.
रप to speak, to revile, Uṇādi aff. असुन्, and ए substituted for the radical vowel.
